parsed.rationale: The two computed properties `HSBColor.uiColor` (line 53) and `HSBColor.nsColor` (line 63) in `Shared/ColorPalette/Sources/ColorPalette/HSBColor.swift` return platform-specific color types (`UIColor` on iOS/tvOS, `NSColor` on macOS). Their structural similarity (Jaccard 0.71) reflects the parallel shape of HSB-to-platform-color conversion, but the two properties are intentionally distinct: they target different Apple frameworks and cannot be collapsed into a single generic function without introducing a platform-abstraction type that would obscure the explicit platform split. No restraint markers are present, but the divergence is domain-driven rather than accidental duplication.
